messages:
Aisha Khan: Planning thread for candidate Lior (senior ML) visiting 2026-06-12. Arrives ~07:10 on red-eye. Onsite interviews 10:00-16:00. Needs wheelchair access, halal meal, quiet room for a 1:1, and an M1 loaner for the coding exercise. Can we confirm badge + parking + loaner pickup flow?
Ben Howard: I can reserve rooms. Recommend Conf C (3rd floor) for quiet coding room since the ramp is right there. Will block 09:45-11:30 for the first session.
Tara Li: Badge noted. I'll pre-create a day pass. What name should be on it?
Aisha Khan: "Lior Patel" (matches passport). Please give visitor door access to Conf C for the day.
Mike Reynolds: Travel stipend + expense form actioned. I emailed Lior with the quick guide and cc'd Sam. I'll monitor flight and post updates.
PeopleOps Bot: Checklist created: badge, loaner, catering, accessibility. Flight monitor enabled for LO-412. Will post ETA changes. :white_check_mark:
Ben Howard: Loaner inventory: one M1 Mac available, asset M1-42. Plan to tag and put in Locker A-3 with charger.
Tara Li: Locker code set to 4821. I'll DM Front Desk the pickup PIN and place badge under "Lior Patel" at the desk by 08:30. No corp keys installed; image will have Chrome, Zoom, Slack. Candidate will use temp VM creds for pairing.
Facilities: Parking pass reserved for Visitor Spot P2-7 from 06/12 06:00-06/13 18:00. Ramp signage placed and front desk notified about accessibility escort.
Ben Howard: Calendar update: shifted first panel 15m later to accommodate a panelist. ICS sent to Lior and interviewers. Zoom fallback included.
Recruiter (Sam): I've reconfirmed itinerary with Lior and reminded them to upload receipts for expenses. Candidate requested halal + GF option.
Aisha Khan: Who can meet Lior at the lobby? I'm arriving same morning and may miss it.
Ben Howard: I can meet them at 07:45 and escort to front desk if needed.
Mike Reynolds: I'll watch LO-412 and ping here if anything changes. PeopleOps Bot will post gate/delay alerts.
Front Desk: Badge and locker instructions acknowledged. We'll hold badge "Lior Patel" and release on ID check.
Aisha Khan: Thanks everyone. I'll loop back if recruiter reports itinerary changes. :pray:
